children.value: > Fact From Story Cranston will start kidney dialysis in January so had no option but to hang up the boots and focus on her treatment and health.

> > Fact From Story Cranston told Fox Footy after the Bulldogs lost to North Melbourne 7.13 (55) to 1.3 (9). “But I go out with on a happy note. I love these girls and I’ll be over at the pancake pocket [Pancake Parlour at Whitten Oval] watching them from now on and have a few bevs on the sideline.”
> > Fact From Story Cranston has battled stage five chronic kidney disease while playing this season.
> > > Fact From Story Cranston lined up for the Bulldogs in her side’s 57-point loss to Sydney on Saturday at Whitten Oval, 14.12 (96) to 6.3 (39).
> > > Fact From Story Cranston was an inaugural AFLW player.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge People retire from sports due to health issues.
> > Commonsense Knowledge It is important to focus on your health when battling a disease.
> Commonsense Knowledge People who need kidney dialysis are suffering from kidney failure.
